caption: The drawing depicts three spoons arranged vertically on a beige background. The top view shows the first spoon from above, with an oval bowl featuring a crest or emblem with the text "EGYPT" and "LUXOR" clearly visible, along with some markings on the handle. The second, middle spoon is oriented with the bowl facing upwards, and its handle has a decorative pattern with a circular hole at the end. The third spoon at the bottom is shown in profile, exhibiting a curved handle and a bowl similar to the first spoon, with the same emblem and text visible. The drawing uses black ink lines on a plain, light-colored paper, with the artist's name "WALT C--N, K" signed in the bottom-left corner.
title: Silver Teaspoon
